book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Yeesu afumya omuja w'omukulu w'abasoda
Yeesu abeere amamala kubwira olubaga lwaliiri kumuyunviriza ebi binwa byooshi, aja eGaperinaumu.
Eyoola, omukulu w'abasoda w'ekirooma aligwerhe omuja waage w'akamaro. Oyo muja alilwere bweneene ey'ali bufa.
Oyo mukulu w'abasoda abeere ayunva yi baderha ebiyerekeere Yeesu, amurhumira abashamuka baguma b'aBayaahudi kumuhema ayinje amufumize oyo omuja waage.
Babeere baagera emwa Yeesu, barhondera kumuyinginga bweneene n'okuderha ntya: «Oyu mukulu w'abasoda akwaneene gurhabaalwa naawe.
Kwenge anasiima olubaga lwerhu, yeewe ye wayumbakisaga esinagoogi yeerhu.»
Nnaweerhu ava agenda nabo. Abeere akola ali hoofu n'enju, oyo mukulu w'abasoda arhuma abeera baage kubwira Yeesu ntya: «Mwigiriza, orhashiibaga wachilibuza. Nyoono ntakwaneene mp'ohike omu mwani.
Chegirhumire ntayinja nyenyine emunda oli. Aliko oderhe chinwa chiguma chonyine y'omuja waani afuma.

Kwenge naani ndi eshiishi w'abanrhegekere na kandi ngwerhe abasoda nyimangiire. Nkabwira muguma ntya: ‹Genda!›, anagenda, na nkabwira owindi ntya: ‹Yinja!›, anayinja; na nkabwira omuja waani ntya: ‹Kola echiila!›, anagikola.»

Yeesu abeere ayunva ebyo binwa, asomererwa oyo mukulu w'abasoda. Ahindamuka abwira ntya echigusho ch'abantu bali bamukulikiire: «Mbabwirire oku ntashubiraga kubona obwemeezi buli ntya, nangwa! Chiro n'omu Israheeli.»
Bala beera omukulu w'abasoda arhumaga, babeere bagaluka bashimaana omuja afumire.
Yeesu afuula omwana w'omushumbakazi
Enyuma z'aho, Yeesu aja omu gishagala chiguma chiyirikwa Naiina. Abigirizwa baage n'echigusho chinene ch'abantu bamuherekeza.

Abeere agera hoofu n'omulyango g'olugo lw'echo gishagala, haahulukira abantu baliiri kuja guhamba omufu. Oyo mufu aliiri mwana w'echinege w'omushumbakazi muguma. Abantu banene b'ahoola baliiri haguma n'oyo mushumbakazi.
Nnaweerhu abeere amubona, amuyunvira obonjo bweneene n'okumubwira ntya: «Orhaliraga!»
Ayegeera n'okuva ahuma oku gipoyi. Abaali giheekere bayimanga. Yeesu aderha ntya: «Musole we, nkubwirire ntya: zuuka!»
Nyagufa azuuka, ayikala n'ogurhondera kuderha. Yeesu amugalulira nyina.
Booshi bayuubaha. Bakuuza Nnamahanga omu kuderha ntya: «Rhwabonekeerwe n'omuleebi mukulu!», na kandi: «Nnamahanga ayinjire gurhabaala olubaga lwage!»
N'omu Yudeeya yooshi na hoofu nayo hooshi, abantu bamenya ebi Yeesu ali ajirire.
Yohaana Mubatiiza arhuma abigirizwa baage emwa Yeesu
Abigirizwa ba Yohaana bamubwira byooshi Yeesu aliiri kujira. Yohaana ahamagala babiri omu bo,
abarhuma emwa Nnaweerhu kumubaza ntya: «Ka wooyo we Masiiya Nnamahanga alaganyaga changwa rhukwaneene kulinga owindi?»
Abo bigirizwa babiri babeere baahika hoofu na Yeesu, bamubwira ntya: «Yohaana Mubatiiza arhurhumire gukubaza ntya: ‹Ka wooyo we Masiiya ogwasizwe kuyinja changwa rhukwaneene kulinga owindi?›»
Mw'akoola gashanji, Yeesu afumya abantu banene endwala zaabo, obulema, n'abazimu, n'okugalulira empumi okubona.
Yeesu ashubiza abigirizwa ba Yohaana ntya: «Muje kubalira Yohaana ebi mwabwene n'okuyunva:

content.text: empumi yi zabona, ebirema yi byalambagira,
ababenzibenzi yi baafuma, ebihuli yi byayunva,
abafu yi bafuuka, n'oMwazi Mwinja yi gwashambaalirwa abakene.

content: Agishwe olaala orhakaleka kunyemeera!»
Abarhumwa ba Yohaana babeere bagenda, Yeesu ava arhondera kubwira ntya olubaga lwali ho elugulu wa Yohaana: «Gichi mwajaagilola omu mpinga? Ka lusheke lushaganyizwe n'omuyaga?
Kandi, gichi mwajaaga kulola? Ka muntu oyambeere emishangi minja? Aliko abayambala emishangi minja n'okulama omu muhimbo bali omu nju z'abaami.
Aliko si, gichi mwajaaga mwaja kulola? Omuleebi? Neechi, mbabwirire okw'ali muleebi, na kandi yeewe alushire omuleebi.
Kwenge Yohaana y'aMandiko Matagatiifu maderhaga ntya elugulu waage:
Mbabwirire oku omu booshi baburhirwe n'abakazi, harhashubiraga kuba omukulu kulusha Yohaana. Aliko, omugeeke bweneene omu Bwami bwa Nnamahanga ali mukulu kumulusha.»
Olubaga looshi n'abafurhiisa b'amakooli bali bamuyunviriize, bayemeera oku Nnamahanga akwaneene, banachibatiziisa emwa Yohaana.
Aliko aBafarisaayo n'abigiriza b'amarhegeko balahiire eki Nnamahanga ashondaga oku bo n'okuva balahira kubatiizwa na Yohaana.
Yeesu ashuba kuderha ntya: «Abantu bali zeene nakabashushanya na nde? Bashushire nde?
Bashushire n'abaana bayikeere embuga, eyi baguma yi bahamagala abaabo ntya:
Amango Yohaana Mubatiiza ayinjaga, arhaliiri kulya emigati n'okunywa edivaayi. Mwamuderha ntya: ‹Agwarhirwe n'omuzimu!›
Leero Mwene oMuntu amayinja, ali kulya n'okunywa. Kandi mwamamuderha ntya: ‹Tala oyu muntu oganiiza okulya konyine n'okunywa edivaayi. Ali mwira w'abafurhiisa b'amakooli n'abandi banyabyaaha!›
Aliko, obwenge bunene bwa Nnamahanga buyinjikeene nka b'okuli oku booshi babuyemeera.»
Yeesu ababalira omukazi w'ebyaaha
oMufarisaayo muguma alaalika Yeesu kulya haguma naye. Aja omu nju yaage, bayikala kulya ebiryo.
Mw'echo gishagala mwaliiri omukazi w'ebyaaha. Abeere ayunva oku Yeesu y'alya emw'oyo Mufarisaayo, aleerha omukebo gw'amarashi.

Ayimanga enyuma za Yeesu, ahaburhambi bw'amagulu maage. Arhondera kulira n'okulobya amagulu ma Yeesu n'emiziga yaage. Ashangula amagulu ma Yeesu n'enviiri zaage, amahoobera, n'okumashiiga kw'amarashi.

Oyo Mufarisaayo walaalikaga Yeesu abeere abona ntyo, achibwira ntya omu murhima gwage: «Oyu muntu nk'aliiri muleebi wa Nnamahanga, singa amenyere oyu mukazi wamuhumire ko ali nde, okw'ali munyabyaaha.»
Yeesu abwira oyo Mufarisaayo ntya: «Simooni, ngwerhe echinwa ch'ogukubwira.» Simooni ashubiza ntya: «Derha, Mwigiriza.»
Yeesu aderha ntya: «Bantu babiri baligwerhe omwinda gw'owabayindikaga. Muguma aligwerhe omwinda gw'edinaari
magana marhaano n'owindi makumi marhaano.
Nka kunoola booshi ntaaye waligalire kumujuha, abababalira booshi oku bali babiri. Nde nji wamusiima bweneene mw'aba babiri?»
Simooni amushubiza ntya: «Nkengereere k'olaala ababaliraga walimugwerhe mwinda munene.» Yeesu amubwira ntya: «Waderhere okuli.»

Ashuba guhindamukira emunda oyo mukazi ali n'okubwira Simooni ntya: «K'obwene oyu mukazi? Najiire omu mwawe, chiro orhampeere amenji m'ogushuka amagulu, aliko yeewe anshukire amagulu n'emiziga yaage n'okumashangula n'enviiri zaage.
Wooyo orhanyankiriire omu kumpoobera, aliko yeewe arhalekere guhoobera amagulu maani gurhengera aha najiriire omu mwawe.
Wooyo orhashiigire amavurha omu rhwe lyaani, aliko yeewe ashiigire amarashi oku magulu maani.
Cho girhumire nkubwirire oku obuzigire bunene anyerekere, buyerekeene okw'ebyaaha byaage binene byababaliirwe. Aliko obabaliirwe bugeeke anayeerekana obuzigire bugeeke.»
Yeesu abwira oyo mukazi ntya: «Ebyaaha byaawe byababaliirwe.»
Abaliiri kulya oku meeza haguma na Yeesu barhondera guchidedeesa ntya: «Oyu ali nde w'okubabalira n'ebyaaha nabyo?»
Aliko Yeesu abwira oyo mukazi ntya: «Obwemeezi bwawe bwaguchungwire; ogende n'omurhuula.»
